correctness.rationale: D_n has independent adjacent mixed-difference rows; every active subset is locally realizable by strict KKT complementarity, so the global infinity norm modulus equals max over P_A=I−D_A^T(D_AD_A^T)^−1D_A. Independently built D from four-corner coefficients and rationally enumerated all 2,16,512 active masks for n=2,3,4, obtaining sharp maxima 3/2,17/9,9/4; exactly mask 341 wins for n=4, while full-pooling mask 511 gives 17/8. The source supplies strictly feasible finite witness at eps 1/100 and proves embedding lower bound for n>4, not equality there.
residual_risks: No exact n>=5 value is claimed; finite exhaustive enumeration is a valid proof only for the finitely many n<=4 active sets.

value.rationale: Provides a complete, natural, low-dimensional stability classification of the anti-Monge least-squares projection; the checkerboard face displaces full pooling at the first possible square size, with an exact sharp finite-pair witness. The precise constant informs deterministic maximum-error amplification of a widely used shape-constrained estimator.
residual_risks: The classification stops at n=4; n>=5 has a lower bound rather than a complete formula.
